description: Compute a league standings table from match results: played, W/D/L, goals for/against, goal difference and points, sorted by points, then goal difference, then goals for, then name. Use when you have scores and want the current table. Do NOT use to generate future fixtures (use round_robin_schedule).

points_draw.description: Points awarded for a draw, non-negative number. Default 1

points_win.description: Points awarded for a win, non-negative number. Default 3

results.description: Completed match results in any order; may be empty if teams is given (zeroed table)

away.description: Away team name (must differ from home), e.g. "Tigers"

away_score.description: Away team score, non-negative integer, e.g. 1

home_score.description: Home team score, non-negative integer, e.g. 3

teams.description: Optional full roster (2+ unique names). Teams with no results appear with zeros; results involving teams not listed are skipped with a warning

name: standings_table

points_system.description: Points scheme applied to compute the table

table.description: Standings rows sorted by points, goal difference, goals for, then team name

warnings.description: Results skipped because a team was not in the roster (empty if none)

title: Standings table
